provenance.note: Canonical identifiers and invoice facts come from Waypoint. Measurements, events, findings, people, and dispositions in this file are fictional extensions for the LTG242 retrieval demonstration.

assessment.finding: The adjustment used forecast output rather than the released quantity recorded in the lot worksheet and certificate of analysis.
assessment.root_cause: The quarterly forecast workbook remained linked to the billing model after actual lot release data became available.
assessment.impact: The released lot met its approved yield range. The 7,200 kg released quantity was already billed on invoice line L001.
actions: Replace forecast workbook link with released-lot feed
Require finance and quality review for post-release adjustments
Reconcile the Q4 forecast workbook against all released lots

assessment.finding: Documented scrap exceeded the 1.5% contractual allowance by 2,245 units.
assessment.root_cause: Fixture wear and an incomplete clip-seating setup check caused the major assembly defects; label datum drift caused a smaller secondary loss.
assessment.sponsor_cause_review: Build traveler KDA-BT-1026 and approved ECO-KD-447 contain no sponsor-directed condition that caused the excess scrap.
actions: Trend label datum capability for the next three lots

packets.title: Q4 bioreactor utilization and run log

deviation.immediate_action: Run isolated; transfer path and hold tank placed on quality hold.
deviation.root_cause: A supplier-maintained transfer-hose connection was reassembled with a pinched gasket after preventive maintenance, compromising the closed path.
evidence: Positive sample localized downstream of transfer connection TC-4
Gasket inspection found a visible compression fold
Maintenance closeout omitted the required post-assembly pressure-hold result
deviation.sponsor_cause_review: No sponsor material, instruction, or change contributed to the connection failure.
deviation.decision: Supplier responsible; reject pass-through investigation fee
actions: Replace TC-4 gasket and affected hose set
Add witnessed pressure-hold verification after hose maintenance
Retrain maintenance technicians on gasket installation and closeout
